hooks.name: Guard Against Stray spaces/ Tree
hooks.description: On every user message, verifies the repo-root 'spaces' entry is the canonical symlink (spaces -> src/research_assistant/spaces) and not a real directory. Catches the recurring bug where an agent follows the docs' shorthand 'spaces/{SPACE}/output/...' literally and creates a stray, git-ignored tree at the repo root. Fails loudly with remediation steps.
